fusions.name: Downpour of Edges
fusions.desc: After a 0.6-second gather, looses 5 falling blades in a fan, each dealing 12 damage and leaving the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Against a boss or an elite each blade also deals 4% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Last Drop
fusions.desc: A falling chop on a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 16 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Washed-Clean Rest
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Wet Wood Splits
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your damage rises by 12%.
